_instructions: 1. For each rule below, paste the official text into the 'paragraphs' array.
2. One paragraph entry per lettered/numbered subparagraph — e.g. Rule 13 (a), (b), (c), (d) become four entries. This is what highlights and margin notes anchor to.
3. Each paragraph entry is an object: { "id": "r13-2", "text": "(b) ...pasted text..." }.

4. Paragraph id convention: r<ruleNumber>-<n> for rules, a<annexNumber>-<n> for annexes, numbered from 1 in reading order. Ids must be unique across the whole file and MUST NEVER CHANGE once users start annotating (annotations are stored against these ids).
5. Include the subparagraph letter — (a), (b), (i), (ii) — at the start of the text so the reader displays it.
6. Do not change any 'id', 'num', or 'title' fields; the app links quiz questions to rules through them.
7. You may delete this _instructions array when done.

8. WHERE THE FINISHED FILE GOES: save it as  seasmart/src/data/colregs.json  (replacing the placeholder file). No other change is needed — search, the reader, highlighting, and question links pick it up automatically.
9. After replacing the file run 'npm run build' once to confirm the JSON parses (a stray quote or trailing comma is the only thing that can break it).
NOTE: any highlights/annotations made against the placeholder text will point at wrong offsets once real text is loaded — fine during development, but load the real text before real users annotate.
